description: He wears a muted burgundy knee-length wool tunic with long sleeves and narrow gold-and-brown woven trim around its short open neckline, cuffs and hem. Cream linen appears at the collar and sleeve ends. A sturdy dark leather belt has an oval brass-colored buckle and a long hanging strap with modest embossed ornamentation and a pointed metal end. Dark brown fitted trousers are tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots.
